reading: [[pray|pray, offer prayers, pay your vows, make a vow, pray for|εὔχομαι]] [[really|really, at all events, surely, so, then and therefore|οὖν]] [[round about|round about, around, about and near, about and for and on account of, about and concerning, for very|περί + genitive]] of me [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]], and [[let take its rest|let take its rest and rest and cease and have done, let leave off from and rest and cease from, let be at rest, let leave off doing|παύω]] [[of the coming into being|of the coming to be, of the arising, of the being brought into existence|γίνομαι]] [[sounds|sounds and tones, sounds of the voice, cries, faculties of speech and discourse, languages, sayings|φωνή]] [[of God|of everything that God is by nature, of deity in full and undiminished kind|θεός]] and [[hail|hail, any pelting shower|χάλαζα]] and [[fire|fire, the funeral-fire, the fire of the hearth|πῦρ]]; and [[I will send quite away|I will send quite away, I will dispatch|ἐξαποστέλλω]] you, and [[no more|no more and no longer and no further|οὐκέτι]] [[you will put to|you will put to, you will hand over and deliver, you will give and bestow, you will impose further, you will attribute, you will add|προστίθημι]] [[to stay stand fast|to stay stand fast and abide, to stay at home and stay where one is and not stir, to stay away from, to stay and tarry, to be lasting and remain and last and stand, to remain as one was and hold good and remain contented, to abide by, to await and expect and wait for|μένω]].

greek: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς Ὡς ἂν ἐξέλθω τὴν πόλιν, ἐκπετάσω τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς κύριον, καὶ αἱ φωναὶ παύσονται, καὶ ἡ χάλαζα καὶ ὁ ὑετὸς οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι· ἵνα γνῷς ὅτι τοῦ κυρίου ἡ γῆ.
hint: Moses says that once outside the city he will spread his hands to the lord, and the storm will stop.

notes.text: And the rain: not in the Hebrew of this verse.
ἐκπετάννυμι, to spread out: Middle Liddell's one translation for the active, plain text.
The earth is the lord's: a verbless clause, the genitive the predicate.

greek: καὶ σὺ καὶ οἱ θεράποντές σου ἐπίσταμαι ὅτι οὐδέπω πεφόβησθε τὸν κύριον.
hint: Yet Moses knows Pharaoh and his servants do not yet fear the lord.

notes.text: You have feared the lord: the Hebrew has YHWH ʾĕlōhîm, the LORD God.

reading: and you and [[the waiting-men|the waiting-men and attendants, the companions in arms, the servants|θεράπων]] of you [[I know|I know, I am able, I am capable, I am assured, I believe that, I understand, I know and am versed in, I am acquainted with, I know for certain and know well, I know that|ἐπίσταμαι]] [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[and not yet|and not yet and not as yet|οὐδέπω]] [[you have been put to flight|you have been put to flight and stand so, you have fled affrighted and stand so, you have fled and stand so, you have been seized with fear and stand so, you have been affrighted and stand so, you have feared and stand so|φοβέομαι]] [[the lord|the lord, the master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]].

greek: τὸ δὲ λίνον καὶ ἡ κριθὴ ἐπλήγη· ἡ γὰρ κριθὴ παρεστηκυῖα, τὸ δὲ λίνον σπερματίζον.
hint: The flax and barley are ruined, for the barley was in the ear and the flax in bloom.

notes.text: Standing ripe, going to seed: the Hebrew has ʾābîb, in the ear, and gibʿōl, in bloom. σπερματίζω, not in Middle Liddell, LSJ's to be in seed, citing this verse.

greek: ὁ δὲ πυρὸς καὶ ἡ ὀλύρα οὐκ ἐπλήγη· ὄψιμα γὰρ ἦν.
hint: The wheat and spelt are not ruined, since they ripen late.

notes.text: πυρός, wheat: Middle Liddell's one translation, plain text.
ὀλύρα, Middle Liddell's ὄλυρα, a kind of grain, spelt or rye, for the Hebrew kussemet.

reading: [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], the wheat and [[the kind of grain|the kind of grain and spelt and rye|ὀλύρα]] not [[was struck|was struck and stricken and smitten, received a heavy blow and was beaten, was stricken|πλήσσω]]; [[late|late and slow, late of fulfilment, late in the season|ὄψιμος]] [[for|for, since and as, for otherwise and else, now, but, why and what, would that|γάρ]], was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one.

greek: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ Φαραω ἐκτὸς τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐξεπέτασεν τὰς χεῖρας πρὸς κύριον, καὶ αἱ φωναὶ ἐπαύσαντο καὶ ἡ χάλαζα, καὶ ὁ ὑετὸς οὐκ ἔσταξεν ἔτι ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν.
hint: Moses leaves the city and spreads his hands to the lord; the thunder and hail stop and the rain no longer falls.

notes.text: Outside the city, ἐκτός with the genitive, the preposition.

greek: ἰδὼν δὲ Φαραω ὅτι πέπαυται ὁ ὑετὸς καὶ ἡ χάλαζα καὶ αἱ φωναί, προσέθετο τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν καὶ ἐβάρυνεν αὐτοῦ τὴν καρδίαν καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ.
hint: When the storm stops, Pharaoh sins again and hardens his heart, he and his servants.

notes.text: He added to sin, for the Hebrew wayyōsep laḥăṭōʾ.

greek: καὶ ἐσκληρύνθη ἡ καρδία Φαραω, καὶ οὐκ ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ, καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.
hint: Pharaoh's heart is hardened and he does not release the Israelites, as the lord had said through Moses.

notes.text: To Moses: the Hebrew has bĕyad-mōšeh, by the hand of Moses.
